relationship.original_equation: Price-to-operating-cash-flow multiple = price per share / operating cash flow per share
relationship.locator: Printed p60, Annexure C, Section E valuation ratios 2, 3, 8 and 9
relationship.translation_notes: Both quantities are currency per one share, so the currency and share basis cancel. The financial observation period remains contextual.
